decision: Traced the PDF findings to the separate backoffice repository and the web proxy routes
why: The two applications own different parts of the reported behavior

decision: Added a separate writer-applications permission across API, page, menu, and seed
why: A users-only administrator could read KYC and approve creators

decision: Validated JSON shape before either PATCH route reads fields
why: Null and malformed input crashed outside the response handling

decision: Kept the existing web attachment proxy
why: Both live HTTP routes returned the same 401, proving the web route forwards to backoffice

decision: Capped creator media range responses at 8 MiB
why: A 100 MiB open range previously read and returned the full file
result: 1 test red then green; 4 media tests pass

decision: Gave each KYC upload its own key and guarded rejected-to-pending updates
why: The previous deterministic key let a losing request replace the winning document
result: 4 tests red then green; v2 document AAD remains open

decision: Checked active punishment inside writer approval transaction
why: An active account alone did not mean the member could sign in

decision: Mapped missing punishment updates to HTTP 404
why: Prisma P2025 previously escaped the route

decision: Bound new writer payloads and withdrawal destinations to their row IDs with separate v2 keys
why: Legacy ciphertext could be copied between records
result: 3 tests red then green; legacy migration pending

decision: Added a dry-run-first v1 to v2 conversion script without running it on production
why: Existing rows need compare-and-swap re-encryption before v1 support can be removed
result: static checks pass; database dry-run and apply unverified

decision: Bound new KYC document envelopes to user, application, and kind; kept v1 read compatibility
why: A ciphertext copied to another owner or application must fail authentication
result: 2 tests red then green; 66 security tests pass

decision: Compared cron Authorization headers with timingSafeEqual
why: Direct string comparison exposed a timing side channel

decision: Deferred private-bucket-only configuration pending legacy writer-document location migration
why: Existing KYC keys have no bucket marker, so switching reads unconditionally would make them unavailable
